newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 12.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 12.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The winter influenza claimed 34 fatalities so far, a total 160,000 people fell ill and many people suffering from flu-related complications.
- Local transport workers in the sout-west Hungarian town of Pecs could go on general strike if wage talks are not successful.
- The imminent overhaul of Hungary's power stations could cost some 750 billion forints.
- There was no significant breakthrough during the hearing of former cabinet members by the Parliament's committee on party headquarters sales.
- Speeding up judicial procedures is the main aim of the planned reform of the legal system, Justice Minister Pal Vastagh said.
